topic: George Sperling (1960) 50-Millisecond Tachistoscope Grid, Post-Flash Tone Partial Report, and 300-Millisecond Iconic Memory Buffer (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Sperling's 1960 Harvard partial-report grid becoming Exhibit A in modern consciousness science separating V1 visual persistence from prefrontal working memory.
